resurfacing of two tennis courts at the us embassy san salvador, including cleaning, repair, leveling, surface painting, and game line application, using laykold advantage system materials provided by us government.

dear contractors, the u.s. embassy in el salvador invites your company to participate in the adjudication process for request for quotations (rfq) 19es6026q0028 for resurfacing of two tennis courts at the us embassy san salvador, including cleaning, repair, leveling, surface painting, and game line application, using laykold advantage system materials provided by us government. please find the scope of work in attachment #1. key information: •rfq number: 19es6026q0028 •questions submission deadline: in site visit scheduled on thursday, august 20th, at 10:00 am local time *in cover letter you will find the information you need to confirm assistance* •quotation submission deadline:   tuesday, september 8th, 2026, at 10:30 am local time •submission method: email to pintoam@state.gov •contact for questions: michelle pinto, pintoam@state.gov thank you for your attention.
on or before september 8, 2026 at 10:30 am local time
design, production, and implementation of a strategically informed, multimedia national campaign in support of the u.s. embassy san salvador’s h-2 visa fraud prevention campaign

solicitation number 19es6026q0031 this is is a request for quotations (rfp) for design, production, and implementation of a strategically informed, multimedia national campaign in support of the u.s. embassy san salvador’s h-2 visa fraud prevention campaign. the campaign will run for three months. please find the scope of work as exhibit a. please ensure you complete and submit all requirements detailed below: *sf-1449 *section i – pricing *section 3 – solicitation provisions *section 4 – evaluation factors *section 5 – representations and certifications *sam registration please submit your questions on or before friday, august 14th, 2026 to pintoam@state.gov
